name: Takatoo Makoto
source:
A first-year student and a member of the Life Research Club. To many, it comes as a surprise that Mikoto is a boy due to his very girly appearance.

[spoiler] Said to have an unusual large penis which is pointed out by protagonist. Despite protagonist jealously this becomes main talking point mostly one side that brings them closer. Is also blackmailed into joining club when the president took a picture of his dick.[spoiler]
